items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Goodman with the trio for a year.

ctx.x: That's right. We got a couple of them here, if we can recall their names. There was Chu Berry and Benny Carter -- very big eaters.
Benny's slowed down now, but yeah, I know what you mean. There you go.

Yeah. And I remember one time we were sitting there eating Chu Berry, and Benny Carter, and Uncle Henry was charging us 35 or 50¢, pitch till you win, and they ate so much, that when they got through, poor Henry gave them their 50¢ back and said don't come back here no more, son!

items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I'm glad you said that; I gave him his first job. >> [INTERVIEWEE] This boy was getting good publicity...

ctx.x: I'm glad you said that; I gave him his first job.
This boy was getting good publicity and they broke him in, he's working, he's juicing too much, but they still are booking him. So that goes to show that things are not all bad.
